title: crepis willdenowii subsp. alikeri
intro: Crepis willdenowii subsp. alikeri, commonly known as Kashmir dandelion, is a plant species belonging to the family Asteraceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as treating various digestive issues, inflammation, and fever due to its antibacterial and anti-inflammatory properties. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to act as a diuretic, anti-diarrheal, and anti-inflammatory agent, making it useful in managing various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Crepis willdenowii subsp. alikeri include sesquiterpenes, phenolic acids, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
